accepted_expr_variants.Lit: stock token-to-literal conversion succeeds; exact kind/value/suffix retained
accepted_expr_variants.Path: no QSelf or explicit arguments; full nonerror resolution; no body-node lifetime/definition effects
accepted_expr_variants.Call: callee/arguments accepted; external bare-path callees require current no-legacy-rewrite proof
accepted_expr_variants.MethodCall: no explicit segment arguments; current segment resolution and exact ordered trait candidates retained
accepted_expr_variants.Field: receiver accepted; exact field Ident/span retained; trait map preserved even when empty
accepted_expr_variants.Binary: ordinary binary operator and accepted operands
accepted_expr_variants.AddrOf: Ref or Raw only, exact mutability; Pin excluded
accepted_expr_variants.Assign: lhs only local path/field/index/deref, rhs accepted; no destructuring assignment
accepted_expr_variants.AssignOp: ordinary assignment operator and same restricted lhs
accepted_expr_variants.If: accepted expression condition, accepted blocks/else; let-chains excluded
accepted_expr_variants.Block: no label, Default or explicit UserProvided unsafe block
accepted_expr_variants.Paren: accepted inner expression, no expression attributes

accepted_statements: Let with wild/identifier binding, optional accepted initializer, no else/type/super/attributes
parameter_patterns: Ident with current local-binding resolution, no subpattern, exact binding mode including self
body_node_rejections: lifetime resolution or extra lifetime parameters
dynamic_effect_gate: unimplemented and unmeasured; actual S/E and complete journal validation required before caching
